headline: 班南蒂獨角秀倫敦登場
context: 美國百老匯女星蘿拉·班南蒂（Laura Benanti），推出65分鐘個人秀《Nobody Cares》，在倫敦Underbelly Boulevard Soho演出。她在劇中笑談自己年輕時當「取悅型人格」的糗事，包括曾在《Into the Woods》演出中斷頸卻選擇隱瞞的往事。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Underbelly Boulevard Soho, London A grab-bag of awkward ‘lessons learned’ by a middle-aged entertainer reflecting on her journey, the US comic’s song-filled show has savour and schmaltz Among Americans, Tony award-winner (“and four-time Tony award loser,” as she self-deprecates here) Laura Benanti is a well-loved Broadway doyenne. But prior to national treasure status (boosted by her popular Melania Trump skits in recent years), she was a blushing innocent, performing on the Great White Way aged 18, being propositioned by bigshot producers and breaking her neck in a revival of Into the Woods. A “pathological people pleaser,” she didn’t raise a fuss, and the injury was covered up. This eyebrow-raising history contains quite enough to justify a 65-minute solo show about being, in Benanti’s words, a “recovering ingenue”. And when that’s what Nobody Cares is, it’s at its strongest. Delivered with musical director Todd Almond plus two-piece backing band, the show is cringingly funny about the younger Benanti’s conflict avoidance, as she lurches from one disastrous relationships to another and squirms out of a marriage proposal in the least appropriate way imaginable. thread_text:
美國百老匯女星蘿拉·班南蒂（Laura Benanti），推出一齣65分鐘的個人秀《Nobody Cares》，正在倫敦Underbelly Boulevard Soho演出。班南蒂在劇中笑談自己年輕時當「取悅型人格」的糗事，包括曾在音樂劇《Into the Woods》演出中斷頸，卻選擇隱瞞傷勢不聲張的往事。這齣戲被形容為，描寫年輕班南蒂如何逃避衝突的段落最有戲。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 18 日發佈的報導。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 18 日發佈的報導。
